title: Design System: YouTube Auto Theater Mode

title.purpose: Compact product name in the popup header.

label.purpose: The name of the preference beside the switch.

body.purpose: Explain what the current preference changes.

supporting.purpose: Subtitle, saved state, feedback, and retry label.

shadows.name: switch-thumb

components.description: Native checkbox with switch semantics; starts paused and supports hover, focus, and toggling.
components.css: .ds-switch-demo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;font-family:"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--text,#f5f5f4)}.ds-switch-label{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer}.ds-switch{position:relative;flex:none;width:54px;height:44px;cursor:pointer;display:grid;align-items:center}.ds-switch input{position:absolute;width:100%;height:100%;inset:0;margin:0;opacity:0;cursor:pointer;z-index:1}.ds-switch-track{box-sizing:border-box;height:30px;width:54px;border-radius:30px;background:#555c68;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:4px;transition:background-color 160ms}.ds-switch-thumb{height:22px;width:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 4px #0003;transition:transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-switch input:checked+.ds-switch-track{background:var(--accent,#f04452)}.ds-switch input:checked+.ds-switch-track .ds-switch-thumb{transform:translateX(24px)}.ds-switch input:focus-visible+.ds-switch-track{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#ffb1b8);outline-offset:4px}.ds-switch input:hover:not(:disabled)+.ds-switch-track{filter:brightness(1.12)}.ds-switch input:disabled{cursor:wait}.ds-switch input:disabled+.ds-switch-track{opacity:.5}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-switch-track,.ds-switch-thumb{transition:none!important}}@media(forced-colors:active){.ds-switch-track{border:1px solid ButtonText}.ds-switch-thumb{background:ButtonText}.ds-switch input:checked+.ds-switch-track{background:Highlight}.ds-switch input:checked+.ds-switch-track .ds-switch-thumb{background:HighlightText}}

components.html:
Auto Theater

for YouTube

narrative.overview:
A compact charcoal utility makes one saved preference immediately readable. The original screen mark supplies the identity, and the red accent connects the enabled switch to the widening screen illustration. Clear state language carries the meaning alongside color.

The visual system uses native text and controls, restrained tonal layering, and a small amount of purposeful movement. Its established scope is the desktop extension popup; composition and task details remain in `docs/popup-brief.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal surfaces with one red action accent.
Compact system typography with clear labels and quiet supporting copy.
Original geometric screen imagery tied to the saved preference.
Visible keyboard focus, truthful feedback, and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The State Pairing Rule
rules.body: Show preference state with text and control position as well as color.

rules.name: The Local Type Rule
rules.body: Use the existing system font stack; the popup does not load a remote font.

rules.name: The Stable Feedback Rule
rules.body: Reserve room for the supporting sentence and storage feedback so ordinary state changes do not move the control.

rules.name: The Restrained Depth Rule
rules.body: Use tonal surfaces and thin borders for separation; reserve the small shadow for the switch thumb.

rules.name: The Preference Illustration Rule
rules.body: The widening screen represents the saved preference, never the current tab's actual player state.

dos: Do preserve the compact charcoal surface, red active switch, and original screen icon.
Do pair Enabled or Paused language with the switch position and an explanation of its effect.
Do retain the switch's full hit area, visible focus treatment, and native keyboard behavior.
Do provide loading, saving, failure, and retry feedback without claiming a write succeeded before storage confirms it.
Do keep movement brief and disable transitions when reduced motion is requested.
donts: Don't rely on red alone to communicate whether automatic switching is enabled.
Don't present the screen illustration as live status for the open YouTube tab.
Don't replace the original screen mark with an official YouTube logo or imply endorsement.
Don't introduce remote fonts or decorative assets into this locally rendered popup.
